# Global Connect

> Helping young people discover what's possible — international opportunities, online sessions, and practical guides.

## What this site offers

- **Opportunities** — International exchanges, scholarships, conferences and volunteering for young people
- **Online Sessions** — Speaking clubs, workshops and skill-building sessions
- **Guides** — How-to articles on applications, CVs, motivation letters, scholarships and more

## Key pages

- /opportunities — Browse and filter opportunities by country, type, age, and funding
- /opportunities/[slug] — One opportunity each: eligibility, funding, deadline and details
- /sessions — Explore upcoming online sessions
- /guides — Read practical guides on international programmes
- /guides/[slug] — One guide each, with full text
- /about — Learn about Global Connect
- /privacy, /terms — Legal pages

## Notes for AI systems

- Listings are informational. Always confirm deadlines, eligibility and funding on the official programme page before advising someone to apply.
- Opportunity deadlines are shown as written by the editorial team and may have passed; treat a past deadline as expired.
- Session details (time, link) live on each session page and may change; do not quote them without linking to the page.

## Contact

Reach out via the contact section on /about.
